name: Bangladesh Cubing Fiesta 2019
information: 1. The competition will take place at the [BU Permanent Campus](https://goo.gl/maps/BwsAkDbcdVLMLCLW9), not on any other campuses spread across Mohammadpur. 2. You'll have to be present at the competition area at least 10 minutes before the start of your event. 3. All the necessary information is given the Tabs, please have a look. 4. Please follow the [Bangladesh Cubing Fiesta 2019 Facebook page](https://www.facebook.com/BangladeshCubingFiesta2019/), all the updates will be posted there.
